register(address,bytes32,string,string,b.notice: Creates version 1 for a token. Reverts if the token already has an entry.

registerVersion(address,bytes32,string,s.notice: Appends the next version (a correction or an update). `kind` and `primaryId` must equal those of version 1: they identify what the token is and cannot be rewritten. Earlier versions stay readable and unchanged.
